items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Me and Louis Armstrong was in the homes at the same time when he was learning. ... And I used to clean Louis and them horns to try to work my way up to the band.

ctx.x: Did you know Louis Armstrong down here?

Me and Louis Armstrong was in the homes at the same time when he was learning. Oh, yeah? Yeah, I tried to get in the band and there had to be an instrument cleaner first. Mm-hmm. And I used to clean Louis and them horns to try to work my way up to the band.
